plan.summary: This 4-week block starts the 12-week parent cycle with an off-camp build emphasis for boxing. Week 1 establishes a baseline on the main lower-body strength lift so later loading can be progressed clearly, and the main training work starts in Week 2. With only 1 S&C session per week and a beginner using minimal home equipment, the session stays full-body, power first, then strength, then practical accessories and short conditioning.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build basic strength and simple explosive qualities with clean technique and recoverable volume.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress strength and power steadily while trimming any work that adds fatigue without clear return.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep the force base and shift more emphasis toward faster, sharper outputs that carry into boxing.
